text: To Steenbarger's hold: the ticket meets my clearing condition only on the print of the new high, and the trigger already waits for it: h1_close_above:bar_high on H1, ACT_NOW. W HH/HL, D above EMA9, 1.71% under the 20-day high: an Upward Trend at its high (C5). Entry 116.84 vs ma_200 67.78 and sma_dist 17.73% are extension, not my danger signal; I do not sell or skip a trend on distance alone (C15). The elder_5d fade is a reaction under way, which is why I buy the next high, not now. Wrong if a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high prints (C7, my translation).
